title: JuggernautSMP
description: JuggernautSMP is a competitive PvP minigame plugin for Minecraft (Paper 1.21) where one player becomes an overpowered boss — the Juggernaut — and everyone else must team up to take them down.
body:
JuggernautSMP is a competitive PvP minigame plugin for Minecraft where one player becomes an overpowered boss — the Juggernaut — and everyone else must team up to take them down.

Perfect for events, tournaments, SMP challenges, or last-man-standing game modes.

⚔️ The Juggernaut Kit (Exact Loadout)

When the event starts, one selected player becomes the Juggernaut and receives:

❤️ Health Boost

40 Max HP (20 Hearts) (configurable in config.yml)

💥 Permanent Effects

Strength

Resistance

Regeneration

Fire Resistance

(All effects are configurable — amplifier and duration can be adjusted in the config.)

🛡️ Juggernaut Gear

Full Netherite Armor set

Mace with maxed enchants

Multiple Totems

Stacks of Enchanted Golden Apples

Juggernaut items cannot be dropped

Items stay protected during the event

🔑 Juggernaut Key (Crafting Recipe)

The plugin includes a custom craftable item called the Juggernaut Key.

Its Cafted with 2 netherite ingots, 4 diamonds, and 3 emeralds

🧠 Game Flow

Admin starts the event.

A player crafts the juggernaut

That player receives the full Juggernaut kit.

All other players must eliminate the Juggernaut.

Event ends when:

The Juggernaut dies

Admin manually stops the event

🛠️ Commands
Main Command

/juggernaut

Subcommands

/juggernaut start → Starts the Juggernaut event

/juggernaut stop → Stops the event

/juggernaut status → Shows current event status

/juggernaut reload → Reloads the config

Alias

/jg

Permissions (example)

juggernaut.admin

juggernaut.start

juggernaut.stop

⚙️ Fully Configurable

Inside config.yml, you can customize:

Max health

Potion effect strength

Potion duration

Gear setup

Crafting recipe

Messages & broadcasts
